subject: financial_literacy
concept: Building a personal long-term wealth-building plan combining net worth tracking, pay-yourself-first saving, multiple income streams, and disciplined investing, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds a personal wealth-building plan chart across a simulated multi-year timeline
exercise.abstract: Student explains their plan's reasoning across net worth growth, saving habits, income diversity, and investing discipline

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan reasonably addresses saving habits, income strategy, and investing discipline together
misconception_flags: plan focuses on only one wealth-building lever while ignoring the others covered in this unit

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
